morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为借词词根记忆；马来语读音保留第二音节的 /a/，不沿用英语的弱化元音。

senses.zh_definition: 符合既定规则、惯例或礼仪的；正式的；正规的。
senses.en_definition: Following established rules, conventions, or prescribed procedures; formal.
senses.ms_definition: Menurut peraturan, aturan atau adat kebiasaan tertentu yang diterima atau dianggap wajar; rasmi.
senses.nuances: 可修饰服装、语言、活动及教育方式。formal 侧重形式、规范与场合要求；rasmi 常侧重官方身份或正式认可，两者并非处处互换。释义依据：[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=formal)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Semua peserta diminta memakai pakaian formal semasa menghadiri majlis tersebut.
dual_scenarios.zh: 请所有出席者穿着正式服装参加该活动。
dual_scenarios.en: All participants are requested to wear formal attire when attending the event.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Esok kena pakai baju formal ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kita perlu memakai pakaian formal esok?
dual_scenarios.en: Do we need to dress formally tomorrow?
spoken_features: kena 在口语中表示必须或需要
句末 ke 是口语疑问标记
baju 在这里泛指衣着，正式表达用 pakaian

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Esok kena pakai baju formal ke? Aku nak siap-siap malam ni.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kita perlu memakai pakaian formal esok? Saya mahu menyediakan pakaian pada malam ini.
messages.zh: 明天要穿正式一点吗？我想今晚先把衣服准备好。
messages.en: Do we need to dress formally tomorrow? I want to get my clothes ready tonight.

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, bos dah pesan. Pakai kemeja je, tak payah tali leher.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, ketua sudah berpesan. Memadai memakai kemeja; tali leher tidak diperlukan.
messages.zh: 对，老板已经交代了。穿衬衫就好，不用打领带。
messages.en: Yes, the boss already told us. A shirt is fine; no tie needed.

etymology.historical_story: Formal belongs to an international vocabulary associated with established forms and conventions. Its English counterpart traces to Latin formalis, related to forma, meaning shape or form. In Malay, the word connects ceremonial clothing, institutional learning, and regulated communication. These uses share a useful cultural image: an activity takes a recognized shape that participants are expected to follow. [Collins](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/formal)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 formal，就想象把衣着和说话方式放进一个规定好的 form：按规矩来，就是正式。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 在马来西亚职场、学校及典礼通知中属于中性、得体的用词；实际服装要求仍应以主办方说明为准。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合说明礼仪、语言及制度要求。形容别人 terlalu formal 可能暗示拘谨或有距离感，当面评论时应注意语气。
